lines: +- Fix #8594: Images in emails already sent (mail header, logo, profile images) broke whenever the published assets were removed, e.g. by the cache flush after every update; absolute `AssetImage` URLs now point to a controller that republishes the image and redirects to it

- Fix #8605: Users of a user source other than "local" could not log in with their password although their source allowed the Password client; a source allowing it also blocked the password login of local users
- Fix #8602: Flaky acceptance test logins when the sign-in form pre-filled a username left by an earlier test
- Enh #8596: Added a `Forward next` CI workflow that merges `develop` into `next` once a day or when started manually (fast-forward or merge commit, fails on a conflict)

+  - Since 1.19.1, an **absolute** URL (`$image->getUrl($options, true)`) is a permanent URL to the `asset-image` controller instead of the published copy: the controller republishes the variant if needed and redirects to it, so the links in emails or Open Graph tags survive a cache flush (#8594). Request absolute URLs only where the image leaves the platform — a page rendering its images with absolute URLs turns every image load into a PHP request. For a direct absolute URL of the published copy (e.g. in API responses) use `Url::to($image->getUrl(), true)`.

* @var string File with path to the AssetImage
+     * Returns the URL of the image.
+     * A relative URL points to the published copy in the assets, which are volatile: they are
+     * removed on every cache flush (so after every update), by a manual deletion of the `assets`
+     * directory or by a redeployment, and republished on the next render.
+     * An absolute URL (`$scheme`) is meant to leave the platform, e.g. in emails or Open Graph
+     * tags, where it is never rendered again. It therefore points to
+     * {@see \humhub\controllers\AssetImageController} instead, which republishes the image if
+     * needed and redirects to its current URL.
* @param array|null $options use `null` use default options, `[]` get unmodified file. All available options in class header
+     * @param bool $scheme whether to return an absolute URL that stays valid as long as the image exists
* @return string the URL, or an empty string if neither an uploaded image nor a `defaultFile` is set
